title: Fast and robust memristive cell based on 2D materials for energy-efficient in-memory computing
description: Simulation and training code for binary neural networks (BNNs) deployed on 1T1R memristor arrays, including two-stage training with a 0/1-weight memristor crossbar classifier, robustness evaluation under noise, quantization and sparsity, and circuit-level 1T1R array simulation. This is the version of the code used in the associated Nature Communications paper.
